LESSON: PROPHET ’S JOURNEY TO TAIF

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: History of Islam
Topic 7.3: Prophet ’s Journey to Taif

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Prophet ’s Journey to Taif
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What lessons can Muslims learn from the Prophet (S.A.W)’s journey toTaif?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. demonstrate the virtues exhibited by the Prophet (S.A.W) in his journey to Taif
2. appreciate the virtues demonstrated by the Prophet (S.A.W) while in Taif

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: demonstrate the virtues exhibited by the Prophet (S.A.W) in his journey to Taif

Teach
• Today’s focus: demonstrate the virtues exhibited by the Prophet (S.A.W) in his journey to Taif.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “demonstrate the virtues exhibited by the Prophet (S.A.W) in his journey to Taif” using a school example.
• Model B for “demonstrate the virtues exhibited by the Prophet (S.A.W) in his journey to Taif” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "demonstrate the virtues exhibited by the Prophet (S.A.W) in his journey to Taif" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: appreciate the virtues demonstrated by the Prophet (S.A.W) while in Taif

Teach
• Today’s focus: appreciate the virtues demonstrated by the Prophet (S.A.W) while in Taif.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “appreciate the virtues demonstrated by the Prophet (S.A.W) while in Taif” using a school example.
• Model B for “appreciate the virtues demonstrated by the Prophet (S.A.W) while in Taif” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "appreciate the virtues demonstrated by the Prophet (S.A.W) while in Taif" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: demonstrate the virtues exhibited by the Prophet (S.A.W) in his journey to Taif
• Model 2: appreciate the virtues demonstrated by the Prophet (S.A.W) while in Taif

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: demonstrate the virtues exhibited by the Prophet (S.A.W) in his journey to Taif
2. Practise: appreciate the virtues demonstrated by the Prophet (S.A.W) while in Taif

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Prophet ’s Journey to Taif.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What lessons can Muslims learn from the Prophet (S.A.W)’s journey toTaif?
2. How did the Prophet (S.A.W) treat the people of Taif?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• demonstrate the virtues exhibited by the Prophet (S.A.W) in his journey to Taif
• appreciate the virtues demonstrated by the Prophet (S.A.W) while in Taif

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
